name: Diorama
description: Sliders and hero sections that are quick to make and fast to load: pick your photos, write a title and a button, done; or place headings, texts, buttons, images and icons on the slide, with a layout for each device, entrance effects, transitions, video backgrounds and Ken Burns. Accessible and light, with ready-made templates, a block for the block editor, a Fresco widget and the latest blog posts as slides. One slider per site; Diorama Pro adds more.
author: Cleitext
